faction.name: AzarEmpire
faction.description:
阿扎兰帝国正在入侵银河系。它们是一个高度集权的帝国，将自己的星球带入银河系，从那里生产舰船来占领行星并建造建筑以增强其生产能力。
<color=#f25e1c>影响可变：</color>根据强度和入侵时间，该派系的影响将大不相同。例如，立即入侵、强度10将在高影响到极高影响之间，而较晚入侵则可能使其完全失败。以下是总体预期： 它们一开始相对较弱，扩张困难，但只要有足够的时间，它们的设施将提供充足的生产力来接管银河系。它们的母星将是一个巨大的行星，能够容纳无数设施，即使没有太多领土，它们仍可能构成威胁！

custom_field.name: Intensity
custom_field.description: 这个派系到底有多可怕？

custom_field.name: Allegiance
custom_field.description: 该派系对 AI、人类友好，还是对谁也不友好？
custom_field.arbitrary_options: Hostile To All,Friendly To Players,Hostile To Players Only,Minor Faction Team Red,Minor Faction Team Blue,Minor Faction Team Green

custom_field.name: InvasionTime
custom_field.description: The Azaran Empire can be set to invade the galaxy at some unknown time during the game, or immediately. An immediate spawn is the scariest, and can sometimes make the game extraordinarily hard.

custom_field.name: SpawnNearPlayer
custom_field.description: Definitely not recommended unless friendly to you.
